To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The MLCT excited state emissions of osmium(II), platinum(II) and iridium(III) complexes can be used as the electroluminescent materials.

the electroluminescent efficiency of the Os complex:PVK: PBD device is improved by the incorporation of a small amount of 2,2 (4,4,6,6) tetramethyl 1,3 cyclohexanediol (TMCD) in the device.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and synthesis of novel luminescent transition metal complexes, the understanding of their photophysical properties and their incorporation in organic electroluminescent devices.
the development of a new class of red electroluminecence materials based on Os complexes.
the development of new materials for electroluminescent devices.

the electroluminescent device is a result of a combination of the triplet MLCT emission of the osmium complex and the singlet MLCT emission of PBD.
the electroluminescent device based on Os complex:PVK is the first example of the electroluminscence of triplet MLCT excited state.
triplet MLCT excited state of transition-metal complexes are good emitters for organic light-emitting devices.

the triplet MLCT excited state emission of the Os complexes is enhanced by incorporating into the PVK matrix.
the triplet MLCT excited state emissions of transition metal complexes can be utilized to produce stable and uniform electroluminescent materials.
